lines.text: Many learners say: I have seen him yesterday.

native.tip: yesterday처럼 정해진 과거는 단순 과거로! “I saw him yesterday”예요.
native.caption: “I have seen him yesterday”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 어제처럼 시간이 정해진 과거에는 현재완료가 아닌 과거형을 써요. “I saw him yesterday”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “saw”. 어제는 saw로! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: With yesterday, use the simple past. Say “I saw him yesterday”.
en.caption: Do you say “I have seen him yesterday”? 😅 A fixed past time like yesterday needs the simple past, not present perfect. “I saw him yesterday” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
